answer_1.quote: We propose to attack by posting semantically similar adversarial tweets as retweets on Twitter, so that they could be identified as relevant information and collected as model input.
datasets: stock prediction dataset consisting of 10,824 instances including relevant tweets and numerical features of 88 stocks from 2014 to 2016

answer_2.quote: Attack performance is evaluated by two metrics: Attack Success Rate (ASR) and victim model's F1 drop after attack.
